raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent hallucinated specific burial details ("Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery" in Chandler) that were not present in the visible viewport or the extracted metadata of the Wikipedia page it was analyzing. The visible text only confirmed the death location as "Chandler, Arizona" and the infobox did not list a specific cemetery name. The agent incorrectly inferred a specific cemetery name and location from the death city, creating a false conflict with the Find a Grave data (City of Mesa Cemetery) rather than recognizing the Wikipedia page lacked the specific burial site information. This led to an incorrect conclusion about the burial place.
